page.title: pharCare demo videos
page.heading: See pharCare in action
page.lede: Short, step-by-step walkthroughs of pharCare, from signing in to GST reports. Watch them in order or jump to the module you need. Every step is captioned on screen, so no sound is needed.
page.description: Watch pharCare demo videos: sign-in, medicine and supplier masters, purchase entry, POS billing, returns, batch and expiry tracking, stock control, GST reports and administration, step by step.

videos.title: Login & Getting Started
videos.description: Sign in with your own username and password, and find your way around the main menu.

videos.title: Dashboard
videos.description: See today's business at a glance — sales, purchases, pending payments, low stock and expiry alerts.

videos.title: Item Master (Medicines)
videos.description: Create and manage medicines — name, manufacturer, tax, schedule, prices and stock limits.

videos.title: Supplier Master
videos.description: Record the distributors you buy from — GST, drug licence, contact details and credit terms.

videos.title: Patient Registration
videos.description: Keep a record of regular customers — contact details, doctor, allergies and loyalty membership.

videos.title: Purchase Entry
videos.description: Receive medicines from a supplier bill — batch, expiry, quantity, free goods, rates and GST — and add them to stock.

videos.title: POS Billing (Sales)
videos.description: Bill medicines to a customer — choose the patient, add items with batch and quantity, take payment and print the invoice.

videos.title: Sales Return
videos.description: Take back medicines against the customer's invoice — the stock goes back to its original batch.

videos.title: Inventory, Batch & Expiry
videos.description: Check stock batch by batch, and catch low-stock, near-expiry and expired medicines before they become a loss.

videos.title: Stock Adjustment
videos.description: Correct stock for damaged, expired or missing units — every change is recorded with a reason.

videos.title: Stock Control, Transfer & Opening Stock
videos.description: Physical stock counts, reconciliation, reorder suggestions, store transfers and first-time stock loading.

videos.title: Reports Center
videos.description: Sales, purchase, GST, stock valuation and expiry reports for any date range — ready to print or export.

videos.title: User Management
videos.description: Give each staff member their own login and role — and switch the login off when they leave.

videos.title: Settings
videos.description: Your pharmacy's details, the billing price rule and the invoice printer — set once, used on every bill.

videos.title: Backup & System Maintenance
videos.description: Protect your data with backups, keep PharCare up to date, and know where your database and stores are set up.

videos.title: Purchase Orders & Purchase History
videos.description: Order stock from a supplier before it arrives, and look up any received bill later.

videos.title: Purchase Analytics & Audit Logs
videos.description: Understand what you buy and from whom — and see who did what, and when, in the system.

videos.title: Production (Formulations & Runs)
videos.description: For pharmacies that make their own preparations — recipes, batch production, quality check and traceability.
